marker-post.description: One post with a coloured cap. Slots substitute, they do not compute (spec §3): the post centre (postY) and cap height (capY) are separate params because no slot can derive height/2 or height+0.04. Defaults are staged for height 1.8.

post-pair.description: Two marker-posts gap metres apart, staged for height 1.8 (the marker-post postY/capY defaults). Demonstrates nested instantiation, param forwarding via slots, and transform composition: each inner instance carries its own transform; neither replaces the template root transform.
